info.title: Shortsmith API
info.description: One line of text in, a ~30-second vertical video out. Local only (127.0.0.1), mock media only, one run at a time.

post.description: Queue a new run. It starts when the worker is free; follow it at `events`.

get.description: The runs, newest first (0 = all), with the worker's status on top of the checkpoint's.

post.description: Answer the hero-clip question of a paused run: yes = the clip, no = Ken Burns for that scene.

Continue a stopped run from its checkpoint (nothing finished is paid for again): after a budget
stop, with a bigger budget; after a crash or a server restart, as it was.

get.description:
The run's events as Server-Sent Events: everything after `after` (or the Last-Event-ID header a
reconnecting browser sends), then new ones as they happen. Ends after `done`; follow=false ends
after the replay. The event types are the models of GET /runs/{id}/log.

200.description: text/event-stream: `event:` = the type, `data:` = one event of GET /runs/{run_id}/log as JSON, `id:` = its id

204.description: The run finished and every event was sent: stop reconnecting

get.description: The run's events so far, as one JSON list (what the stream would replay).

schema.title: Response Run Log Runs  Run Id  Log Get

get.description:
A file inside the run folder (images, voices, clips, critic frames, final.mp4). Range requests
work (FileResponse), so the browser can seek in the video. Nothing outside the folder, ever.
The ledger by day, run, model and step; list price next to billed; today's free-tier use.
What `shortsmith doctor` checks, as data: never a key, the database URL masked.

Allowance.title: Allowance
Allowance.description: OpenAI's complimentary daily tokens, as the settings describe them.

ApprovalNeeded.title: ApprovalNeeded
ApprovalNeeded.description: The hero-clip question (graph.HeroQuestion). With policy "ask" the run pauses here.

BudgetStopped.title: BudgetStopped
BudgetStopped.description: Stopped before a node that would take the run over its budget; nothing was sent for it.

CriticReport.title: CriticReport
CriticReport.description: One critic round, as the graph keeps it (RunState.critic_rounds).

Failed.title: Failed
Failed.description: A node failed, or the server stopped mid-run. The checkpoint keeps everything finished: resumable.

GroupToday.title: GroupToday
GroupToday.description: One OpenAI data-sharing group since 00:00 UTC, by our ledger.

HeroPlan.title: HeroPlan
HeroPlan.description: The one paid clip of a video, and whether a person said yes to it (Step 6.6).

MediaMade.title: MediaMade
MediaMade.description: One file of a producer pass: the page shows the thumbnail now, not after the whole pass.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: Every refusal: one line on what is wrong, one on what to do (as the CLI's error + next).

Queued.title: Queued
Queued.description: Accepted, waiting for the worker (one run at a time).

RerunRecord.title: RerunRecord
RerunRecord.description: One rerun, as reruns.json keeps it.

budget_usd.title: Budget Usd
budget_usd.description: A new budget (list price), saved with the run.

Revision.title: Revision
Revision.description: One scene's change in one round: kept in the state (RunState.revisions, appended).

RunStarted.title: RunStarted
RunStarted.description: The worker took the run: a new run, or a resume (after an answer, a budget stop or a crash).

SceneChange.title: SceneChange
SceneChange.description: One revised scene (reviser.Revision, with `changed` spelled out: it's a property there).

ScriptChecks.title: ScriptChecks
ScriptChecks.description: Facts code measures before the critic reads the script: an LLM counts words badly.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: What the video is about, in a few words.

research.title: Research
research.description: YouTube trends + the hook library (needs the database).

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: A brand in data/hooks/brands/; implies research.

approve.title: Approve
approve.description: The hero-clip question: ask (pause for a person), yes, or no.

budget_usd.title: Budget Usd
budget_usd.description: Hard limit for the whole run, LIST price.

StartRun.title: StartRun
StartRun.description: POST /runs. The same choices as `shortsmith make`, minus --real (mock only in this phase).

VideoInfo.title: VideoInfo
VideoInfo.description: What ffprobe says about a finished file: used for the summary and the live tests.

VideoMade.title: VideoMade
VideoMade.description: The editor cut final.mp4 (again, after each revision round).
